boundaries: Representative manual observations use production Views with fixture services and fine pointer. No physical touch/native VoiceOver or Orca acceptance is implied.
No live backend upload/restore, analytics account synchronization, remote map routing or GIF asset motion was accepted.
No count/age history retention cap was found in inspected local API/schema/contracts/deployment source. A 100-row request maximum is distinct from retention; live DB/external jobs were not inspected.
Controlled React transform render counts and browser samples are not FPS or native latency. Reorder consumers still have a known non-drag click/tap alternative gap for WCAG 2.5.7.
Cookie choices follow cited EDPB first-layer refusal/non-preselection direction; no prescribed exact labels/geometry or legal certification is claimed.
Ready for local human design review, not design approval or deployment. Earlier reports remain historical snapshots.
